in_marathi.name: Bhashini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Speech
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhashini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhashini is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhasha' which means speech. This name is a tribute to the Goddess of Speech and Learning, Saraswati. It is believed that a child named Bhashini will be blessed with the gift of eloquent speech and a sharp mind.
